title: X-Tra Villagers
description: This adds more villagers to Minecraft!
body:
## Villager Mod

Adds **6 custom NPC villagers** that generate naturally inside Minecraft villages, each with their own house and a unique mechanic.

## The 6 Villagers

| Villager | What they do |
|---|---|
| 🗡️ Hired Guard | Follows and protects you. Wears iron armor, deals 5 hearts damage. Only you can dismiss them. |
| 🏹 Bounty Hunter | Right-click to set a bounty target — kill that mob type for emerald rewards. |
| 🏦 Banker | Right-click to deposit / withdraw emeralds. Storage persists across sessions. |
| 🛏️ Innkeeper | Right-click to rest and heal. |
| 📚 Scholar | Opens a shop GUI — buy any enchanted book at any level using emeralds. |
| ⚰️ Gravedigger | Records your inventory on death so you can retrieve your items. |

## Commands

- `/vspawn guard / bounty / banker / innkeeper / scholar / gravedigger` — Spawn any villager manually
- `/villager house <type>` — Build that villager's house at your location

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.16.9
- Fabric API
